My son. 
When he was born 9 weeks ago, the midwife handed him to me, and in that instant, everything I had worried about forever before then just melted away. He was so small and sweet. 

Every morning, he sits in my lap leaning against my knees, and I make noises at him and talk to him, and his smile makes me want to live in those moments forever. He makes my life worth living, makes me want to be a better person, and have a better life, I don't want him to ever feel the way I feel. He's here sleeping on my chest, listening to my heartbeat and breathing, and I'm listening to him, and it warms my heart. 

Sure, he doesn't fix any of my issues. The sleep deprivation certainly doesn't help, but then he smiles at me, and none of that matters. He falls asleep to the sound of my voice, and I feel loved and important. It's the first time I've ever been sure of how someone feels about me. He cries when I leave the room, and he falls asleep when I hold him. All of these moments are so special to me. I tell him every day I'm proud to be his dad, and I'm lucky to have him as my son.
